moments.title: Why two investments cannot be compared like for like without standard metrics
moments.summary: The speaker explains that investments with different features — one left to grow ten years, another with money taken out and put back in — cannot be compared fairly unless the same measurement assumptions are used, which is why the financial world developed standard metrics.
moments.evidence: not fair to compare them like to like unless they have metrics that actually use the same sort of assumptions to measure them.
